title: hoshidicts ga test dictionary
author: hoshidicts
description: A tiny Irish dictionary for languages/ga/tests/lookup.tsv, written for the pack. fuil, dearna and rinn stand for nouns that an irregular verb form looks like once its mutation or ending is removed; beartas and beart for an -as noun beside a shorter word; caolas and turas for -as nouns whose lenited genitive the Munster -ais past would read as the adjectives caol and tur without the lenited condition; páirtí and páirtigh for a plural that a verbal adjective could read; at and the row atá for a form whose own rows name two verbs.
